content: This information is not intended to replace the advice of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive details about this product and to address your specific health needs. Adding plans enables you to compare the formulary status of this product with other medications in the same class. To access formulary information, you must first create a list of plans. This list will be saved and can be modified at any time. Adding plans allows you to perform comparisons effectively. The information provided here is for general informational and educational purposes only. Individual plans may differ, and formulary details are subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, contact the relevant plan provider directly. When sending information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions on how to access the offer.
